notes.title: Official Release Confirmed
notes.content:
We are happy to advise that Steam have now completed their review of the game and as such we have confirmed the release date for the game.

[b]Dating Life: Miley X Emily [/b]- [i]a short fun, yuri romance story, will be released on[/i]...

[h1]July 31st 2019[/h1]

It will include achievements and a directors cut patch will be available from our dedicated website for our games. Hopefully trading cards can be released shortly after the games launch once steam give the thumbs up as per their standard practices.
